title: 🧩 Miscellany
description: Niche interests, now and then: architecture, design and deep-tech outlets kept out of the regular feeds

items.title: [Dezeen] HTA Design unveils "UK's largest council housing development"
items.content_html:
A collection of brick-clad buildings containing over 450 homes forms Kidbrooke Park Road in London, which architecture studio HTA Design claims is the largest council housing development in the UK.

The post HTA Design unveils "UK's largest council housing development" appeared first on Dezeen.

items.title: [Dezeen] "Sacred" archaeological finds become raw materials for design in Ex Situ exhibition
items.content_html:
New objects made from mammoth bone, leather from the middle ages and stumps from a road built under Roman Emperor Hadrian feature in the Ex Situ project, set to be exhibited soon in The Hague.

The post "Sacred" archaeological finds become raw materials for design in Ex Situ exhibition appeared first on Dezeen.

items.title: [Dezeen] Domes depict constellations of missiles in the night sky at Sharjah Architecture Triennial
items.content_html:
Architect Mohamad Nahleh and architecture professor Ozayr Saloojee created three domed structures at this year's Sharjah Architecture Triennial, which reimagine constellations by mapping military objects in the night sky.

The post Domes depict constellations of missiles in the night sky at Sharjah Architecture Triennial appeared first on Dezeen.

items.title: [Pitchfork] Glitter
items.content_html: Each Sunday, Pitchfork takes an in-depth look at a significant album from the past, and any record not in our archives is eligible. Today, we revisit the superstar’s infamous eighth album and film soundtrack, an effervescent blend of retro synth-pop, aughties hip-hop, and piano balladry with legendary baggage.

items.title: [Dezeen] ZHA completes “secular” Théâtre Royal de Rabat in Morocco
items.content_html:
UK studio ZHA took visual cues from the riverbank site of this national theatre in Morocco when designing its sweeping exterior form, which contains a trio of performance spaces.

items.title: [Dezeen] Unprecedented Design Museum exhibition surveys "the beauty and the depth of Black design"
items.content_html:
Work from 16 of the most exciting Black designers working today has been brought together under one roof for the first time as part of The Nue Black Aesthetic exhibition at London's Design Museum.

The post Unprecedented Design Museum exhibition surveys "the beauty and the depth of Black design" appeared first on Dezeen.

items.title: [Dezeen] "All over the world, buildings designed to be explored in 3D are subject to restrictions"
items.content_html:
Controversy over visitors having to pay to access the walkable roof at the new Shanghai Grand Opera House highlights the need for architects to be realistic about how buildings operate, writes Aaron Betksy.

The post "All over the world, buildings designed to be explored in 3D are subject to restrictions" appeared first on Dezeen.

items.title: [Dezeen] Framery's flexible pod subscription tackles office furniture waste issue
items.content_html:
According to office pod brand Framery, when companies resize or move, desks and meeting-room furniture often aren't deemed "worth the cost of moving" and are discarded during the process. items.content_html:
A primer on planning a civic building whose users arrive for a dozen different purposes, and whose image is still a room full of shelves.

items.title: [Dezeen] Waugh Thistleton Architects set to transform derelict bathing pavilion into Tracey Emin-backed studios and sauna
items.content_html:
UK studio Waugh Thistleton Architects is set to transform the Edwardian Westbrook Pavilion in Margate, UK, into an arts centre for British artist Tracey Emin with a cafe, public sauna and changing rooms.
